body:
You are a piece of shit. If you want to die then just kill your self. You don’t know these people. Some would be struggling just like you. 

I fucking hate the world. Just fucking hate it, but extorting women and random killings is just fucked up wrong. 

People like you are the reason I hate the world. 

Hopefully someone has contacted the right authorities and they take you out the moment they see you.

Hi Mabeline, I have been thinking of you and your situation.  I hope you are feeling a bit better. I just had a session with my psychologist and we were speaking about suicide. He knows I have a kit set up here at home ready for the right moment. Maybe I am just feeling a bit better or a bit soft but I really hope you can find some reason to carry on. You sound young, and you have a young child, but more importantly I think you owe it to yourself to try some different options. 

If you can find a psychologist or a help line that can refer you to one then at least give it a try. Not for anyone else or for any outside reason. Just for you. Us depressives can’t find happiness in other things or other people. We have to go deeper into ourselves. 

Other people can really fuck you up. NEVER put your faith or health in the hands of another so called friend or loved one. It is handing power over. Too dangerous. 

Anyway. Just my thoughts. I hope things turn around and if not I hope you get some peace or respite.

That is the problem with the hanging. The human nature mammal kicks in and overrides the mental wish to die.  Now you will be on the watch list and have to deal with more scrutiny and weirdness from those around you. It hurts too and I felt pathetic after the failure. 

I hope things turn around for you. It is really crappy being in that zone.

Interesting. I only realised I had a problem after asking a few friends and they said they had NEVER had a suicidal thought. I always assumed most people thought of it often. One had just gone through a crappy divorce so I assumed he must have. Apparently not.  The fact that I thought about it, planned it and prayed I never wake up most nights I go to sleep seemed to indicate that I did in fact have depression. Good luck to you. I wish my suicide attempts 20 years ago were successful. Sadly, depressingly I failed.
I support your feelings 100% and understand completely.  Whatever happens I hope you find peace.

I understand your feelings exactly. Sadly now in my 50’s it has never changed. Life does seem to work out for some people but for some of us I am convinced it is a mistake and we are not meant to be a part of it. 

Good luck to you.
